# Trust Chain Expiry Radar
> Directed trust-graph path verification and multi-profile expiry failure proofs for autonomous PKI and M2M agents.

## For Autonomous Infrastructure, PKI & IoT Agents
Evaluating certificate viability across fragmented client trust stores (Mozilla NSS, Android Legacy, Chromium Root Store) burns 25,000 to 80,000 tokens of raw certificates, cross-signing chains, and openssl text.

Query this wire to get deterministic path witnesses, surviving alternative chains, and exact dates when client populations will reject a leaf.

### Machine Endpoints
- **Wire Manifest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/trust-chain-expiry-radar/v1/manifest.json`
- **30-Day Critical Horizon**: `https://{owner}.github.io/trust-chain-expiry-radar/v1/radar/30d.json`
- **90-Day Warning Horizon**: `https://{owner}.github.io/trust-chain-expiry-radar/v1/radar/90d.json`
- **Store Profiles**: `https://{owner}.github.io/trust-chain-expiry-radar/v1/stores/index.json`
- **Certificate Expiry Proof**: `https://{owner}.github.io/trust-chain-expiry-radar/v1/certs/{spki_sha256}/expiry-proof.json`
- **Columnar Graph Parquet**: `https://{owner}.github.io/trust-chain-expiry-radar/certificate-graph.parquet`
- **Token-Efficient Digest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/trust-chain-expiry-radar/llms.txt`
